symptom_short: Cluster non-DFS-used space is doubled after a dead datanode re-registers

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded; created PROGRESS.md and state.json.

Fix committed to trunk (c4a85c6) AND cherry-picked to branch-2.x. The doubling ONLY manifests on branch-2.7: there register()->addDatanode() does stats.add(d) with the STALE nonDfsUsed BEFORE updateHeartbeatState(EMPTY) clears it. Trunk/2.8/2.9 already reset before add, masking the bug (verified: trunk pre-fix reproduction shows correct 10000, no doubling). So the faithful pre-fix tree is branch-2.7: fix=f90b9d2 (also patches HeartbeatManager.register ordering), pre_fix=b516235. private/fix.diff is the 2.7 fix; fix.trunk.diff kept for reference.
Built hadoop-hdfs 2.7.4-SNAPSHOT -am from branch-2.7 pre-fix with JDK8+protobuf2.5.0 image. No pom edits needed (toolchain-only). hadoop-hdfs jar + all failure-path classes compiled.

Verified zero bug-id/nonDfs leakage in source/+symptom.log+symptom.md.
